reason: The problem is real, I only look at those receipt groups when something smells wrong and I know money slips through. But I'm not handing a full export of my work chats, with transfer screenshots and bank details, to a bot I've never heard of from a company that might be gone by next season.
objection: Who is behind this and will it still exist in a year? If it disappears I've trained my staff around a dead bot, and meanwhile some stranger has seen all my payments.
would_change_my_mind: Another villa owner I know telling me they've used it for months and it caught real duplicate payments, so I'd know it's legit and sticking around.
